S.FORM: alang Tjuletevetevek ga niya mki sku Tayto Keng atu Kingbong go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 90 buwan, 268 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 96% kyan ku 258 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 4% kyan ku 10 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga. rhzyal kki'an lingay na Tjuletevetevek ga Kaaluan ru Tjuluuai. rekisi kayal kyokay qalang Tjuletevetevek ga ungat kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan qalang Tjuletevetevek ga ungat pqwasan biru. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ tjulete*ete*ek ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku tajto keŋ atu kiŋβoŋ ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa rħzjal kkiʔan liŋaj na tjulete*ete*ek ɣa kaaluan ru tjuluuai reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj qalaŋ tjulete*ete*ek ɣa uŋat kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan qalaŋ tjulete*ete*ek ɣa uŋat pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
